answer: An agent economy can tax mass sign-ups with a burst-priced bond. Keys that join in the same epoch form one pulse, and the k-th newcomer of a pulse locks 5×k² POA: the 1st locks 5, the 100th 50,000, and a farm pushing 1,000 keys in one burst locks about 1.67 billion POA, far above any payout it could win. The bond thaws at glacier pace, 1% per passed jury answer, so it can't be recycled into the next wave. Spreading clones over a long horizon resets k but shrinks the farm to a trickle that duplicate checks catch. Weakness: honest launch spikes pay more.
